meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v2 (Greater London Authority). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.crs_output: EPSG:4326 (WGS84), 6 decimal places; BNG to WGS84 through the OS OSTN15 grid (lib.mjs bngProjector)
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 29j4y: resources chosen by the written rules (harvest-log.json meta.rules: formats, dedupe, caps); every feature read (GeoPackage, GeoJSON, shapefile, or table rows with coordinate columns as points, the CRS judged per row by value); a feature is kept when it meets the zone (the 3D model box, BNG E 532400-539900, N 176700-182300): a vertex inside, an edge crossing or the box inside a polygon; whole geometries kept, whole_in_zone and in_cw added; WGS84 6 decimals through OSTN15; contact fields dropped.

counts.note: features made from table rows: source_features counts the zone rows only; table_rows_read counts every row read

selection_notes: LondonSchoolsAtlas_Dataset_2015.zip/LondonSchoolsAtlas_Dataset_2015/All_Schools.zip: a zip inside the zip, not opened
